rule.description: A recurring group of parameter names (at least three shared names) travels through the signatures of at least five definitions in the production package instead of being carried by one encapsulating abstraction; receivers (self/cls) and catch-alls (*args/**kwargs) are ignored so that only genuinely repeated data items link definitions.

checks.description: Detect every definition whose formal parameters repeat the task-listing control group together with at least four other definitions, linked by shared parameter names.
checks.detected_relation: definition -> recurring listing-control parameter group shared with other definitions across the pipeline
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The task-listing controls (filter values, sort field and direction, received-time window, search text, paging window) always travel together but are restated as individual formal parameters in signature after signature, which is the data-clump relation of a group belonging in one well-designed abstraction.

excluded.reason: Reads DataTables wire intake fields (draw, order column, order direction, start, length, search text) that are consumed inside the handler; draw and order metadata never continue into the listing pipeline, so the intake itself is intentionally outside the recurring control group.

The task map and task id set plumbing shared by the engine's phase helpers and the iteration path is only two names, below the rule's three-name linking minimum, and never travels outside the index boundary.
Search document construction fields are converged into one record object at a single construction site and read as attributes afterwards; they do not travel signature to signature.
Broker connection settings are parsed once into attribute state on one object rather than repeated as a parameter caravan; their construction is also pinned by the repository's frozen unit tests.
